en.answer: In the proposed scenario, since the targeted card cannot be destroyed as a result of the effect of <<10479>>, the part of the effect that adds a card from the deck to the hand cannot be applied.
en.question: If the effect of <<10479>> is activated in a chain to the activation of the Pendulum Effect of <<11809>>, targeting the card in your other Pendulum Zone, how does this resolve?
